items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 28 at 1:54PM AKDT until October 28 at 2:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
A lingering band of patchy dense fog will linger along Knik Arm from
the Knik River Bridge southwest to Lake Hood and Anchorage Int'l
Airport through this afternoon. However, widespread dense fog is no
longer expected for the remainder of the afternoon.
items.areas: Anchorage; Anchorage Hillside / Eagle River; East Turnagain Arm; Portage; Lower Matanuska Valley; SW Kenai Peninsula; NW Kenai Peninsula; Skilak Lake

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 28 at 1:21PM AKDT until October 29 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

Talkeetna Spur Road.

* WHEN...From 2 AM to 1 PM AKDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. The hazardous conditions
will impact the Thursday morning commute. Roads, and especially

items.instruction:

items.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued October 28 at 1:21PM AKDT until October 30 at 2:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow expected. Visibility one quarter mile or less at
times. Total snow accumulations 7 to 15 inches.

* WHERE...Northern Susitna Valley, including the Parks Highway
corridor through Broad Pass.

* WHEN...From 1 PM Thursday to 2 PM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult, with low visibility and
rapidly accumulating snow along the Parks Highway.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Light snow will fall overnight tonight through
Thursday morning, with 3 to 6 inches accumulation
items.instruction:
A Winter Storm Warning for snow means severe winter weather
conditions will make travel very hazardous. If you must travel, keep
an extra flashlight, food and water in your vehicle in case of an
emergency.

For the latest road conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.description:

items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 28 at 3:47AM AKDT until October 31 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 2 to 4 feet above the normal high tide
expected during the Thursday and Friday high tides.

* WHERE...Hooper Bay.

* WHEN...From 7 AM Thursday to 1 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Beach property, the lowest buildings, and the access
road may be threatened. Multiple high tide cycles above normal
may lead to localized beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Water levels of 1 to 3 feet above the
normal high tide line are expected along the rest of the Yukon
Delta Coast.
items.instruction: Precautions should be taken to protect property.
